response.sql: WITH country_counts AS (SELECT p.birth_country, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.player_id) AS player_count FROM player_college AS pc JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pc.player_id GROUP BY p.birth_country), country_stats AS (SELECT player_count, 1.0 * player_count / SUM(player_count) OVER () AS share, AVG(1.0 * player_count) OVER () AS overall_average FROM country_counts) SELECT SUM(player_count) AS total_player_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(player_count - overall_average) AS average_excess FROM country_stats WHERE player_count > overall_average

assumptions.assumption: A NULL birth_country forms one group when calculating country counts and the overall average.

alternatives.interpretation: Exclude players whose birth_country is NULL, since no country is recorded for them.
alternatives.sql: WITH country_counts AS (SELECT p.birth_country, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.player_id) AS player_count FROM player_college AS pc JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pc.player_id WHERE p.birth_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.birth_country), country_stats AS (SELECT player_count, 1.0 * player_count / SUM(player_count) OVER () AS share, AVG(1.0 * player_count) OVER () AS overall_average FROM country_counts) SELECT SUM(player_count) AS total_player_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(player_count - overall_average) AS average_excess FROM country_stats WHERE player_count > overall_average
